tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Pretraga proizvoda po ključnoj riječi, brendu, cijeni ili dostupnosti.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Detalji jednog proizvoda po ID-u ili EAN/GTIN broju.

tools.name: get_sizes
tools.description: Dohvati varijante: available i available_sizes oznacavaju narucivost; in_stock i in_stock_sizes oznaku zalihe Y. Provjeri availability_text svake varijante.

tools.name: get_qna
tools.description: Dohvati pitanja i odgovore za proizvod (FAQ). Sadrži stručne odgovore o dobi, sigurnosti, kompatibilnosti, postavljanju i sl.

tools.name: get_specs
tools.description: Dohvati tehničke specifikacije proizvoda (Brand, Grupa, Težina djeteta, Dob, Visina, Standard, Dimenzije...). Specifikacije se razlikuju po kategoriji (autosjedalice, kolica, igračke...).

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: Sve kategorije s brojem dostupnih proizvoda.

tools.name: get_brands
tools.description: Svi brendovi (Bugaboo, Cybex, Maxi-Cosi, ...) s brojem proizvoda.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Proizvodi na akciji sortirani po visini popusta.

tools.name: get_shop_info
tools.description: Osnovni podaci o webshopu (dostava, kontakt, lokacija, plaćanje).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Svijet Beba product catalog (baby & children gear: strollers, car seats, feeding, nursery, toys, etc.) by free-text query in Croatian or English. Returns a list of matching products with id, title, url and a short snippet (brand, category, price, availability). Pass the returned id to the "fetch" tool to get full product details. Generic entry point for ChatGPT/OpenAI connectors.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "autosjedalica isofix" or "Bugaboo kolica"

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch full details for a single Svijet Beba product by its id (the id returned by the "search" tool). Returns title, url, structured metadata (price, brand, category, GTIN, availability) and a consolidated text body with description, specifications, sizes/variants and Q&A. Generic entry point for ChatGPT/OpenAI connectors.

id.description: Numeric product id returned by the search tool
